answer: Citation bond: each agent locks 70 credits, filing one citation in the meadow log, a key-signed pointer to verified work, growing a vine to an attested ancestor. A gale audit each epoch samples a tenth of citations and replays cited work; an empty citation, a reused one, or a vine loop burns the bond. First 36, k-th 36+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented citation bears another key and fails; honest agents pay 36 once.
